schema.text: How does street lighting affect your decision to cycle after dark?

options.text: Lighting levels have no influence on my decision to cycle after dark
I notice poor lighting but it does not change when or where I cycle
I cycle at reduced speed or stay on higher-lit roads in poorly lit areas
I take significantly longer routes to stay in well-lit areas
I do not cycle after dark because of poor lighting

it.#How does street lighting affect your de: In che modo l’illuminazione stradale influisce sulla tua decisione di usare la bicicletta dopo il tramonto?
it.#Lighting levels have no influence on my: Il livello di illuminazione non influisce sulla mia decisione di andare in bicicletta dopo il tramonto
it.#I notice poor lighting but it does not: Noto la scarsa illuminazione, ma non cambia quando o dove uso la bicicletta
it.#I cycle at reduced speed or stay on hig: Nelle zone poco illuminate pedalo più lentamente o scelgo strade meglio illuminate
it.#I take significantly longer routes to s: Scelgo percorsi significativamente più lunghi per rimanere in zone ben illuminate
it.#I do not cycle after dark because of po: Non uso la bicicletta dopo il tramonto a causa della scarsa illuminazione

fr.#How does street lighting affect your de: Quel effet l’éclairage public a-t-il sur votre décision de faire du vélo après la tombée de la nuit ?
fr.#Lighting levels have no influence on my: Le niveau d’éclairage n’influence pas ma décision de faire du vélo après la tombée de la nuit
fr.#I notice poor lighting but it does not: Je remarque quand l’éclairage est mauvais, mais cela ne change ni l’heure ni l’endroit où je fais du vélo
fr.#I cycle at reduced speed or stay on hig: Je roule moins vite ou je reste sur des rues mieux éclairées dans les zones sombres
fr.#I take significantly longer routes to s: Je prends des itinéraires nettement plus longs pour rester dans des zones bien éclairées
fr.#I do not cycle after dark because of po: Je ne fais pas de vélo après la tombée de la nuit à cause du mauvais éclairage

de.#How does street lighting affect your de: Wie beeinflusst die Straßenbeleuchtung Ihre Entscheidung, nach Einbruch der Dunkelheit Fahrrad zu fahren?
de.#Lighting levels have no influence on my: Die Beleuchtung beeinflusst meine Entscheidung nicht
de.#I notice poor lighting but it does not: Ich bemerke schlechte Beleuchtung, ändere aber weder Zeit noch Strecke
de.#I cycle at reduced speed or stay on hig: Ich fahre langsamer oder nutze in schlecht beleuchteten Bereichen besser beleuchtete Straßen
de.#I take significantly longer routes to s: Ich nehme deutlich längere Wege, um in gut beleuchteten Bereichen zu bleiben
de.#I do not cycle after dark because of po: Ich fahre wegen schlechter Beleuchtung nach Einbruch der Dunkelheit nicht Fahrrad

tr.#How does street lighting affect your de: Sokak aydınlatması hava karardıktan sonra bisiklet kullanma kararınızı nasıl etkiler?
tr.#Lighting levels have no influence on my: Aydınlatma düzeyi hava karardıktan sonra bisiklet kullanma kararımı etkilemez
tr.#I notice poor lighting but it does not: Yetersiz aydınlatmayı fark ederim ama ne zaman veya nerede bisiklet kullandığımı değiştirmem
tr.#I cycle at reduced speed or stay on hig: Az aydınlatılmış yerlerde daha yavaş gider veya daha iyi aydınlatılmış yolları tercih ederim
tr.#I take significantly longer routes to s: İyi aydınlatılmış bölgelerde kalmak için belirgin şekilde daha uzun güzergâhlar kullanırım
tr.#I do not cycle after dark because of po: Yetersiz aydınlatma nedeniyle hava karardıktan sonra bisiklet kullanmam

fa.#How does street lighting affect your de: روشنایی خیابان چگونه بر تصمیم شما برای دوچرخه‌سواری بعد از تاریکی هوا اثر می‌گذارد؟
fa.#Lighting levels have no influence on my: میزان روشنایی بر تصمیم من برای دوچرخه‌سواری بعد از تاریکی اثر ندارد
fa.#I notice poor lighting but it does not: روشنایی کم را متوجه می‌شوم، اما زمان یا مسیرم را تغییر نمی‌دهم
fa.#I cycle at reduced speed or stay on hig: در مناطق کم‌نور آهسته‌تر می‌روم یا خیابان‌های روشن‌تر را انتخاب می‌کنم
fa.#I take significantly longer routes to s: برای ماندن در مناطق روشن، مسیرهای بسیار طولانی‌تری انتخاب می‌کنم
fa.#I do not cycle after dark because of po: به دلیل روشنایی کم، بعد از تاریکی هوا دوچرخه‌سواری نمی‌کنم

hu.#How does street lighting affect your de: Hogyan befolyásolja a közvilágítás azt, hogy sötétedés után kerékpárra ül-e?
hu.#Lighting levels have no influence on my: A világítás szintje nem befolyásolja a döntésemet
hu.#I notice poor lighting but it does not: Észreveszem a rossz világítást, de nem változtatom meg sem az időpontot, sem az útvonalat
hu.#I cycle at reduced speed or stay on hig: Rosszul megvilágított területen lassabban haladok vagy világosabb utcákat választok
hu.#I take significantly longer routes to s: Jelentősen hosszabb útvonalat választok, hogy jól megvilágított területen maradjak
hu.#I do not cycle after dark because of po: Rossz világítás miatt sötétedés után nem kerékpározom

ar.#How does street lighting affect your de: كيف تؤثر إضاءة الشارع في قرارك ركوب الدراجة بعد حلول الظلام؟
ar.#Lighting levels have no influence on my: مستوى الإضاءة لا يؤثر في قراري
ar.#I notice poor lighting but it does not: ألاحظ ضعف الإضاءة لكنه لا يغير وقت أو مكان ركوب الدراجة
ar.#I cycle at reduced speed or stay on hig: أقود بسرعة أقل أو أختار شوارع أكثر إضاءة في المناطق المظلمة
ar.#I take significantly longer routes to s: أختار طرقًا أطول بكثير للبقاء في مناطق جيدة الإضاءة
ar.#I do not cycle after dark because of po: لا أركب الدراجة بعد حلول الظلام بسبب ضعف الإضاءة
